name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text:
Do this: Run a weekly manual audit of the 20% of links that drive 80% of traffic. Flag dead links and redirects in a shared sheet. Fix only the ones that break user flows—ignore cosmetic or low-traffic ones.

Trade-off: We accept slower full coverage to hit the +5%/day gate faster. Manual triage is slower than automation but guarantees we don’t waste time on noise while still pushing the critical links over the finish line.

name: Scriv
text: Manual audits won’t scale—traffic shifts weekly, so yesterday’s "top 20%" is today’s noise. Worse, we’ll waste time fixing links that break nothing while missing new dead ones in the long tail. Simpler: automate a weekly scan of *all* links, rank by traffic impact, and auto-flag only those that break user flows. Settle it with a 24-hour spike: build the scraper, run it on a sample, and compare its false-positive rate to the manual sheet.
